insurer_name: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: 2 year waiting period applies to listed specified ailments; 36 months for pre-existing diseases.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured; room rent capped at Rs.2000/day for SI ≤ Rs.2 Lakh, no cap above.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes room, ICU, nursing, surgeon, OT, drugs, implants and diagnostic costs.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: 539+ day-care procedures covered up to Sum Insured.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Covered when condition prevents hospital transfer or no room available.

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in recognised AYUSH hospitals.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Coverage from Day 1 for newborn baby.

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered for transplant to insured.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to 1% of SI subject to maximum Rs.2,000 per hospitalisation.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: 100% restoration of SI for unrelated claims; recharge benefit for related claims (SI ≥ Rs.3 lakh).
restoration_benefit.notes: Not applicable for claims due to road traffic accidents.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Once in two claim-free years, up to defined limits.

room_rent_capping: Rs.2000/day for SI Rs.50,000 / 1L / 2L; no room rent cap for SI above Rs.2 Lakh.
icu_capping: No specific ICU cap mentioned; included under inpatient hospitalisation.
copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-pay applies if treatment is taken in Tier-1 city when policy was rated for Tier-2 location.
permanent_exclusions: Cosmetic or aesthetic surgery (unless reconstructive after accident/cancer)
Treatment due to substance abuse or alcohol
War, riots, civil commotion, nuclear/radioactive contamination
Dental treatment unless arising out of accident
notable_exclusions_summary: Cosmetic, dental (non-accidental), refractive corrections, infertility, self-inflicted, substance abuse, war, hazardous sports and overseas treatment are excluded. Pre-existing diseases are excluded for the first 36 months.
claim_process_summary: In-house claim settlement team; 24x7 helpline 1800 208 9100; WhatsApp 7305234433. Cashless authorisation through network hospitals or reimbursement via claim form with discharge summary and bills.
